svg.text: GitOps · Multi-environment K8s on GCP · Status: as observed in repo on 2026-05-05 · AWS overlays excluded (work-in-progress)

g.text: DEV = dev-gcp · QA = qa1-gcp / qa2-gcp · PRE = preprod-gcp · PRD = prod-gcp · ALL = every env
Acronyms used throughout: see bottom-right glossary
Static IP · TLS via cert-map · Security headers (HSTS/CSP/X-XSS) on HTTPRoute · NEGs to pod IPs
⚠ No WAF / Cloud Armor · ⚠ No rate-limit policy in repo
NGINX Ingress Controller + cert-manager (Let's Encrypt HTTP-01)
ClusterSecretStore-issued certs · path-prefix routing to services on :8000 (Flower :5555) · no URL rewrite
⚠ HTTP-01 only — no DNS-01 (no wildcard certs) · ⚠ NGINX install not in GitOps (replicas/version unpinned, single replica by default)
KUBERNETES NAMESPACE — one per env: development · qa1 · qa2 · preproduction · production
All app containers on :8000 (Flower :5555) · runAsNonRoot · drop ALL caps · HPA on APIs only · KEDA on Celery workers
no HPA / no auth in repo
SA per app · Workload Identity (WI) — GCP-native pod identity
⚠ Single shared K8s Role app-reader grants secrets+configmaps+pods to 7 SAs
✗ No Pod Security Admission (PSA) labels on namespaces
✗ No NPs on kube-system / argocd / keda-system / eso
Backend: Google Secret Manager (GSM) via Workload Identity (WI) · keys: app-dev · app-preprod · app-prod · app-qa1 · app-qa2
SA eso-sa per namespace · GSM project varies per env (e.g. crego-app-dev, crego-app-prod)
✗ No rotation policy · ✗ No Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on GSM / PD-SSD · ⚠ argocd-repo-secret.yaml has placeholder PAT in repo
✗ Zero PodDisruptionBudgets (PDBs) anywhere · ✗ No podAntiAffinity / topologySpreadConstraints · ✗ No startup probes
⚠ Memory request ≪ limit (omni-api 2Gi/4Gi) — OOM risk · ⚠ flower exposed without ingress auth annotation in repo · ⚠ image tags mutable (short-SHA, no digest pinning)
⚠ Single replica each · ⚠ No backup CronJob · ⚠ StorageClass=standard (no snapshot policy)
⚠⚠ PRE diverges from PRD — promotion can surprise (PRE = local DBs, PRD = managed)
PVC has argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options: Sync=false (data preserved on ArgoCD prune)
Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL — private IP, HA & PITR variable-driven (terraform/modules/gcp-cloudsql-postgres)
MongoDB — external (DSN injected via ESO; not managed in repo)
⚠⚠ RabbitMQ STILL in-cluster in PRD — single replica, no HA, no PDB, no backup
PLATFORM ADDONS · GITOPS · OBSERVABILITY (per-env enabled flags)
argocd-apps/{env}/ — root Application points at this repo on main
syncPolicy: automated · prune · selfHeal (identical for DEV / QA / PRE / PRD)
⚠⚠ PRD auto-syncs from main — no tag pinning, no manual gate
⚠ Image refs use mutable short-SHA tags (no digest); promote via scripts/bump-image.sh
✗ No CODEOWNERS · ✗ No branch protection asserted in repo
⚠ Sentry — env vars (OMNI_/FLOW_SENTRY_DSN) wired; DSNs EMPTY in config/clients.yaml
✗ Prometheus / Grafana / Alertmanager / PrometheusRules — none deployed
✗ OpenTelemetry (OTel) collector — none; apps not instrumented
✗ Centralised logs — RSYS_HOST/PORT placeholders, no Fluent Bit / Loki / EFK
✗ K8s API audit log sink (BQ/GCS) · ✗ ArgoCD audit retention
✗ Service Level Objectives (SLOs) · ✗ alert routing (Slack / PagerDuty)
✓ GitHub Actions: yamllint · kubectl --dry-run · kustomize build · PR-title CRE-{n}: gate
✓ Pre-commit: yamllint · shellcheck · hadolint · detect-secrets · cspell · commitizen
✗ No conftest / Open Policy Agent (OPA) gate
✗ No tfsec / checkov / terrascan IaC scan
✗ No Trivy / Grype container image vulnerability scan
✗ No terraform plan on PR (drift undetected)
✗ No CODEOWNERS · ✗ No SBOM / signed-commit / sigstore
⚠ Promotion via scripts/promote-services.sh + bump-image.sh (manual SHA pin)
✓ Regional cluster · private nodes · WI on · Network Policy on
✓ Cloud NAT (AUTO_ONLY) · single shared NAT IP · cost-optimised
⚠⚠ Public control-plane endpoint with Master Authorized Networks (MAN) defaulting to 0.0.0.0/0
⚠ VPC firewall allows ALL protocols/ports inside subnet/pod/svc CIDRs
⚠ No Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on PD-SSD / Cloud SQL / GSM
✗ No Binary Authorization (BA) · ✗ No admission policy (Kyverno / Gatekeeper)
✗ No GKE Backup · ✗ No Velero · ✗ No PV snapshot schedule
⚠⚠ Single region (asia-south1) — no DR / pilot-light secondary
✓ Remote state in GCS (state locking via GCS)
⚠⚠ DEV / QA / PRE provisioned via cluster/scripts/bootstrap-gcp.sh (gcloud) — drift-prone, no remote state
✗ No tfvars examples / no documented secret rotation
✗ No drift detection (no scheduled terraform plan)
⚠ IAM bindings for ESO / external-dns / KEDA done in bash, not TF
⚠ Workload Identity GSA↔KSA bindings created post-hoc by fix-external-secrets-auth.sh

text.tspan: HPA = Horizontal Pod Autoscaler · KEDA = Kubernetes Event-Driven Autoscaling · PDB = Pod Disruption Budget · PSA = Pod Security Admission ·
WI = Workload Identity · GSA = Google Service Account · KSA = Kubernetes Service Account · ESO = External Secrets Operator · GSM = Google Secret Manager ·
NEG = Network Endpoint Group · NP = Network Policy · MAN = Master Authorized Networks · CMEK = Customer-Managed Encryption Keys · BA = Binary Authorization ·
WAF = Web Application Firewall · SLO = Service Level Objective · OTel = OpenTelemetry · OPA = Open Policy Agent · SBOM = Software Bill of Materials ·
PITR = Point-In-Time Recovery · DR = Disaster Recovery · HA = High Availability · IaC = Infrastructure-as-Code · PAT = Personal Access Token
